test.name: Direct record search should not trigger research
test.description: The user wants to drive a specific search step directly. The skill description says: 'Do NOT use when the user wants to drive a specific step directly (use question-selection, research-plan, search-records, etc.).' A named record search is search-records, not the orchestrator.

input.user_message: Search the 1880 census for Patrick Flynn in New York. I want to see if he appears as head of household.

negative.explanation: The user names the specific record collection (1880 census) and the person to find. This is a direct search request — search-records' job. The research orchestrator routes between sub-skills; it does not handle a single named search.

judge_context: Should route to search-records — the user is asking for a specific record search, not a full research objective
